message.content: {"needs_revision": true, "reasoning": "The code uses StratifiedKFold to build out-of-fold predictions and a stacker, which is legitimate internal CV on training data only, so no leakage there. However, the stacker is trained on OOF probabilities from models that were fit on the same folds, and the final models are refit on full data—this is standard stacking and acceptable. The real critical issue is that the HGB path uses OrdinalEncoder fit per-fold correctly, but the final encoder is fit on full training data (fine) and reused at predict (fine). No P0 leakage or P1 metric bug is present; accuracy threshold at 0.5 with balanced classes is reasonable. The main correctness concern is that `class_weight='balanced'` combined with a 0.5 threshold may bias predictions, but that is not a contract violation. I find no P0/P1 bugs requiring revision.", "revised_code": null}
